periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique-vertical orientation, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid, with the vertical dimension approximately 2.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering where the patch narrows toward the inferior margin near the muzzle.
